tools.name: ingatlan_search_listings
tools.description: Search the live listings of otthon & üzlet (otthonesuzlet.hu), Hungarian homes and shops for sale or rent with sealed offers. Returns a page of listings (code, url, title, address, asking prices, deadline, a short summary) and the same search's catalogue_url. A search needs three conditions: a place

tools.name: ingatlan_get_listing
tools.description: One listing's public page: facts, asking prices and deadline, the neighbourhood (nearest stop, school, shop…), the floor plan by level, photo links, and how to make an offer (on the page, after a Google sign-in). An ended listing says so.

tools.name: ingatlan_how_to_post
tools.description: Where and how a seller posts a listing (a link they open and sign in to), and the kinds, building types and nearby filters there are.

tools.name: ingatlan_draft_fields
tools.description: What a listing draft asks — the kinds and building types, the general fields and every property fact with its type, options, bounds and when it applies. Call it before asking the seller; narrow it with kind, building and deal. Needs the seller's sign-in.

tools.name: ingatlan_save_draft
tools.description: Save the seller's listing as a DRAFT — never live: the seller opens its activate_url, adds the photos and the map pin, accepts the terms and posts it. Checked by the posting form's rules; if something is missing or wrong, nothing is saved and the message says what to ask. At most 3 drafts; give draf

tools.name: ingatlan_list_drafts
tools.description: The seller's drafts: id, title, last saved, and the activate_url the seller opens to post it. Needs the seller's sign-in.

tools.name: ingatlan_discard_draft
tools.description: Discard one of the seller's drafts, for good. Ask the seller first. Needs the seller's sign-in.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.otthonesuzlet.hu" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ingatlan_search_listings, ingatlan_how_to_post, ingatlan_list_drafts · Public sink: ingatlan_how_to_post, ingatlan_list_drafts.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ingatlan_search_listings, ingatlan_how_to_post, ingatlan_list_drafts · Public sink: ingatlan_how_to_post, ingatlan_list_drafts

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "ingatlan_search_listings" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
